## 1. Executive Overview & Identity

Pravesh Singh is an Indian software engineer, entrepreneur, and the Managing Director and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) of SoftEdge Technology Solutions. Over a 15+ year engineering career, he has designed and delivered mission-critical healthcare platforms, multi-tenant SaaS products, deterministic automation pipelines, and enterprise systems across public and private sectors in India and internationally.

### Core Roles & Commercial Entities
- **Pravesh Singh (Direct Advisory):** System Architecture Audits, Fractional CTO Retainers, ABDM/Compliance Integration Sprints, and Technology Due Diligence.
- **SoftEdge Technology Solutions (Managing Director & CTO):** Full-cycle turn-key platform engineering, dedicated development squads, SLA-backed maintenance, and enterprise software contracts. (https://softedgetechnology.com)

---

## 2. Platform Architecture & Capability Pillars

### 2.1 Mission-Critical Healthcare Systems
- **National Standards Interoperability:** Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) M1, M2, and M3 milestone certification, HL7 FHIR R4 JSON document bundle authoring, SNOMED CT and LOINC clinical terminology mapping, and ECDH encrypted health information exchange (HIP / HIU).
- **Offline-Tolerant Clinical Architecture:** SQLite/IndexedDB client-side data stores with monotonic Lamport vector clocks and conflict-free CRDT synchronization engines designed to function uninterrupted during electrical outages and unstable 4G networks at Indian district hospital OPD counters.
- **Double-Entry Biological Logistics:** Cryptographically balanced inventory ledgers for high-value cold-chain clotting factors (Factor VIII / IX). Complete elimination of phantom stock through batch lot tracking, FEFO (First-Expired, First-Out) locking, and cold-chain temperature telemetry monitoring.

### 2.2 Multi-Tenant SaaS Product Engineering
- **PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS):** True shared-schema tenant isolation utilizing session-scoped tenant IDs (`SET LOCAL app.current_tenant_id`) enforced across PgBouncer transaction pooling modes.
- **High-Concurrency API Design:** Sub-50ms REST/GraphQL endpoints with Redis caching, read-replica routing, and automated audit logging.
- **Enterprise RBAC & Compliance:** Fine-grained role-based permissions, comprehensive immutable event logs, automated migration pipelines, and SOC2/ISO-aligned security controls.

### 2.3 Applied AI & Deterministic Data Extraction
- **Schema-Constrained Generation:** Structured LLM parsing using JSON Schema, Pydantic invariants, and instructor pipelines rather than brittle raw prompting.
- **Deterministic Validation & Delta Retries:** Automated mathematical verification of extracted line items and bounding-box citation anchoring across complex clinical discharge summaries and invoices.
- **Targeted Document ETL:** Automated extraction pipelines with human-in-the-loop exception queues achieving >99.4% field-level precision.

### 2.4 Fractional CTO & Architectural Advisory
- **Codebase & Security Audits:** Comprehensive analysis of architecture scalability, query efficiency, data isolation integrity, and technical debt.
- **DPDP Act 2023 Compliance:** End-to-end data fiduciary roadmaps covering Consent Managers, Purpose Limitation, Right to Erasure, and Notice mechanisms.
- **Hiring & Technical Strategy:** Engineering team leadership, technical roadmap planning, vendor selection, and board-level technical representation.

## 3. Flagship Software Platforms

### 3.1 iCare — Clinical Registry & Cold-Chain Biological Logistics Platform
- **Subpage:** https://praveshsingh.com/icare.html
- **Domain:** Hemophilia and Thalassemia clinical management, biological drug inventory, and state-wide health coordination.
- **Live Deployments:** State health networks and medical colleges across Punjab and Madhya Pradesh.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  1. *Portable Patient Profiles:* Centralized clinical registries enabling patients to receive verified clotting factor transfusions at any connected district hospital without carrying paper files.
  2. *Cold-Chain Inventory & Stock Balancing:* Real-time tracking of high-cost Factor concentrates, batch-level expiry monitoring, and algorithmic inter-hospital stock balancing before local stockouts occur.
  3. *State Health Department Oversight:* Live dashboards for State Blood Cell authorities, Mission Directors (NHM), and clinicians detailing patient demographics, treatment compliance, and factor consumption.
  4. *ABDM FHIR Compatibility:* Structured patient records exportable as encrypted FHIR R4 Diagnostic and CarePlan document bundles.

### 3.2 TaskEdge — High-Velocity Operations Task Management SaaS
- **Subpage:** https://praveshsingh.com/taskedge.html
- **Domain:** Enterprise operations, deskless workforce management, shift handovers, and compliance task tracking.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  1. *True Multi-Tenant Isolation:* Secure tenant separation at the database and application levels.
  2. *Frictionless Shift Handovers:* Structured handover notes and task verification protocols preventing operational lapses during shift rotations.
  3. *Zero-Training Interface:* Designed for rapid adoption by deskless supervisors and field workers without specialized IT training.
  4. *Audit & SLA Tracking:* Automatic timestamping, location verification, and tamper-evident task completion records.

### 3.3 Applied AI Automation & Extraction Engines
- **Subpage:** https://praveshsingh.com/automation.html
- **Domain:** Document digitization, clinical summary extraction, automated invoice processing, and verified retrieval systems.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  1. *Structured Extraction Pipelines:* Converting legacy unstructured PDFs and scans into validated JSON records.
  2. *Deterministic Verification:* Automated mathematical validation of table calculations and field boundaries.
  3. *Citation-Anchored RAG:* Enterprise knowledge retrieval systems strictly grounded in verified technical and clinical manuals with zero open-ended hallucination.

## 5. Commercial Engagement Packaging

- **Subpage:** https://praveshsingh.com/expertise.html
- **Contracting Transparency:** Clear distinction between direct personal advisory by Pravesh Singh and turnkey platform builds executed by SoftEdge Technology Solutions.

### 5.1 Standardized Engagement Formats

1. **System Architecture & Codebase Audit**
   - *Format:* Fixed-Scope, 2-Week Sprint
   - *Ideal For:* Growth-stage startups, acquisition due diligence, and platforms experiencing scaling or reliability bottlenecks.
   - *Deliverables:* Exhaustive architectural report, query optimization plan, security & isolation review, and prioritized 90-day technical roadmap.

2. **Fractional CTO & Technical Advisory**
   - *Format:* Monthly Retainer (10–20 Hours / Month)
   - *Ideal For:* Seed/Series A founders needing senior technical leadership, architecture steering, team hiring, and board representation.
   - *Deliverables:* Bi-weekly architecture reviews, PR/RFC oversight, technical hiring candidate interviews, and emergency architectural escalation support.

3. **ABDM & Healthcare Integration Sprint**
   - *Format:* Fixed-Scope, 4 to 6-Week Turnkey Sprint
   - *Ideal For:* HealthTech platforms, EMR/EHR vendors, and hospital chains requiring ABDM M1/M2/M3 compliance and sandbox certification.
   - *Deliverables:* Production-ready ABDM gateway microservice, FHIR R4 schema mapping, cryptographic consent engine, and certified sandbox audit sign-off.

4. **Custom SaaS & Platform Engineering**
   - *Format:* Milestone-Based Engineering Contract
   - *Ideal For:* Enterprises and founders requiring complete ground-up platform development with full IP assignment and SLA-backed support.
   - *Deliverables:* Full-stack web/mobile application build, multi-tenant database infrastructure, CI/CD pipeline, and complete engineering handoff runbooks.

## 6. Technical Thought Leadership Essays

- **Writing Hub:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/

### 6.1 Architecting Offline-Tolerant Software for Indian District Hospitals
- **URL:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/offline-tolerant-hospital-software.html
- **Abstract:** In-depth technical breakdown of engineering clinical software that operates reliably in resource-constrained district hospital environments suffering from power disruptions and erratic connectivity. Covers IndexedDB/SQLite local storage, Lamport timestamp vector clocks, state machine reconciliation, background synchronization queues, and transactional data integrity at hospital counters.

### 6.2 ABDM Integration: A Pragmatic Engineering Guide for HealthTech Developers
- **URL:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/abdm-integration-developer-guide.html
- **Abstract:** A production-level developer guide to integrating with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM). Details ABHA number verification flows, HIP and HIU gateway asynchronous webhook lifecycles (`/v0.5/`), FHIR R4 JSON document bundle structure (`DiagnosticReportRecord`, `PrescriptionRecord`), cryptographic consent artifact validation, and ECDH health data encryption.

### 6.3 Multi-Tenant Database Isolation in PostgreSQL: Schemas vs Row-Level Security
- **URL:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/multi-tenant-postgresql-isolation.html
- **Abstract:** Architectural comparison between Schema-per-Tenant and Shared-Schema with Row-Level Security (RLS) in PostgreSQL. Analyzes PgBouncer connection pooling behavior, connection memory footprint, database migration latency, noisy-neighbor query performance, and strict security isolation policies.

### 6.4 Double-Entry Inventory Ledgers for High-Value Cold-Chain Medicines
- **URL:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/high-value-medicine-inventory-logistics.html
- **Abstract:** Applying immutable double-entry financial ledger accounting principles to biological pharmaceutical inventory (Anti-Hemophilic Factor). Demonstrates zero-sum journal entries, batch-level FEFO allocation with PostgreSQL `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, cold-chain telemetry tracking, and inter-hospital stock balancing.

### 6.5 Structured Data Extraction with LLMs: Pushing Beyond Prompt Engineering
- **URL:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/structured-data-extraction-llm-limits.html
- **Abstract:** Technical essay examining why unstructured prompt engineering fails in enterprise data extraction. Outlines architectural solutions using schema-constrained grammar sampling, Pydantic model validation, mathematical invariant checks, citation coordinate anchoring, and targeted delta retry loops.

### 6.6 DPDP Act 2023: An Engineering Architecture Checklist for HealthTech Platforms
- **URL:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/dpdp-act-2023-health-tech-checklist.html
- **Abstract:** A comprehensive 10-point architectural checklist for engineering teams building health platforms under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023. Covers Consent Manager state machines, Purpose Limitation schemas, cryptographic scrubbing for Right to Erasure, data fiduciary access control, and immutable audit logs.

## 8b. Key Claims & Facts by Essay (machine-quotable)

1. **Offline-Tolerant Hospital Software** — Local SQLite/IndexedDB write paths must commit in under 15ms; reconnection floods are absorbed by batch sync transactions with idempotency keys and server cursors; clinical events are immutable, demographics converge via column-level CRDTs, inventory is a double-entry ledger.
2. **ABDM Integration Guide** — Gateway calls are asynchronous (HTTP 202 then /v0.5/ webhook callbacks); milestones: M1 ABHA verification, M2 care-context linking, M3 consent-driven FHIR R4 exchange with ECDH encryption; production needs idempotent webhook processing and PII-free logging.
3. **Multi-Tenant PostgreSQL Isolation** — Shared-schema RLS beats schema-per-tenant at scale (single migrations, PgBouncer transaction-pool friendly); schema-per-tenant fits <100 high-compliance enterprise tenants; composite indexes leading with tenant_id keep RLS fast.
4. **Cold-Chain Inventory Ledgers** — Every movement is a balanced debit/credit journal entry; on-hand stock is a derived SUM (zero phantom stock); FEFO allocation uses SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
5. **Structured Data Extraction with LLMs** — Four failure modes of naive prompting: schema drift, hallucinated fields, silent arithmetic errors, unverifiable provenance; production stack: schema-constrained decoding + Pydantic invariants + delta-retry + bounding-box anchoring; >99.4% field-level precision.
6. **DPDP Act 2023 Checklist** — Right to Erasure vs statutory medical retention is resolved architecturally: consent-manager state machines, purpose-limitation schemas, cryptographic scrubbing of identifiers while retaining clinical fact, immutable audit logs.
